title: Can I BEAT Sergeant's Checkers?
summary: Sergeant's Checkers (online community variant, 3+2, seen from the side): blue vs green armies of Sergeants on a 14x10 board with cut corners; each Barrelina (royal king) sits boxed in a corner behind stone bricks and two enemy Soldiers. Win by putting your Barrelina on the 2x2 central hill; a side that is stalemated WINS. Game 1 vs Chaco won (he stalemated us), game 2 vs killertofu lost (we stalemated him).
rules: Sergeant: moves and captures one square forward or diagonally forward (0:01); sergeants on the first two ranks may move two on their first move, diagonally too (2:32).
Barrelina (royal, fleur-de-lis): moves one square diagonally, captures only straight forward (0:01, 6:28, 14:50); it attacks the square in front of it.
Soldier (two per side, guarding the ENEMY barrelina's pocket): moves and captures only straight ahead (0:43).
Sergeants promote to Kings on the 13th rank (0:01). Kings cannot capture Kings (7:54).
Win: Barrelina on the central 2x2 hill (0:01, game text 'Reach the hill'); a stalemated side wins (8:15, 14:50). Checkmate presumably wins (inferred).
win_condition: Barrelina reaches the central 2x2 hill, or the opponent stalemates you (stalemated side wins).

board.shape_notes: seen from the side: 14 columns x 10 rows, top and bottom rows only columns 4-11 (cut corners); 2x2 hill outlined in the centre; brick tiles around each barrelina pocket
